steps.en: Install the extension from your browser's store and refresh the page
steps.zh: 从浏览器商店装上扩展，刷新网页

steps.en: Pick a service: the no-key free default, your own API key, Ollama, or a downloaded local model
steps.zh: 选翻译服务：默认免费服务、自带 API key、Ollama 或本地模型

steps.en: Choose the target language and click Translate this page
steps.zh: 选目标语言，点“翻译此页面”

steps.en: Sends the page's paragraphs to that service, rotating free endpoints when one is throttled
steps.zh: 把页面段落发给所选服务，免费端点被限流就换下一个

steps.en: Inserts each translation beneath its original paragraph, restorable in one click
steps.zh: 把译文插在每段原文下面，一键可恢复原页面

value.en: Foreign pages read with the original and the translation side by side, on the engine you choose — free, your own key, or fully on-device
value.zh: 外文网页原文译文对照着读，引擎由你定——免费、自带密钥，或完全在本机跑

sources: README.md Installation @ main 2026-10-08: install the extension and refresh the webpage; select a target language; choose 'Translate page'
docs/en/guide/getting-started.md: 'Click Translate this page. Translations appear below the original paragraphs'; 'Restore this page'; default Free translation service works without configuration

docs/en/config/translation-engines.md: free service rotates enabled free endpoints with rate-limit cooldown; Ollama (local) at http://127.0.0.1:11434, start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*; local model translation downloads OPUS-MT packs / Hy-MT2 1.8B
